Do not open registrations and qualifiers at the same time. Give the teams a 1-week announcement/registration buffer, *then* run the qualifiers. \n\nRight now, everyone is arguing over the roof tiles before the foundation is even poured.       "text": "**Defining the Core Structure**\n\nI\u0027m now zeroing in on the fundamental structure of this concept. The 2v2 match format is a key element, even with a larger team size. The idea of allowing teams of 3-4 players, with 2 active in each match, sparks exciting strategic possibilities. This allows specialization and offers a workaround for scheduling conflicts. However, I\u0027m weighing the potential for organizational complexity, and who gets to decide who plays which match. No subs, no bench.
